name: Adventure Camp (Summer Camp)
description_short: A state-licensed full-day summer camp in Nashua for children entering grades 1 through 7. Activities include swimming, field trips, trips to NH state parks, sports, arts and crafts, and STEM. The Learning Center also runs vacation camps during the February and April school breaks.
swim_waterfront_notes: The page lists swimming as a summer camp activity. It does not say where campers swim or how swimming is supervised.
